guide.title: 痛苦术士 · 团本攻略

provenance.note: Frozen source and central facts; central build is NOT current client 70575.

children.html: We're mainly using custom macros for Pets because the normal functionality of [[spell:119898]] proved unreliable in the past.
Pet Ability 1 Macro -- Casts your main pet abilities for each pet on your mouseover target.

data.code:
/cast [@mouseover]Singe Magic
/cast [@mouseover,exists]Spell Lock;Spell Lock
/cast [@mouseover]Suffering
/cast [@mouseover,exists]Seduce;Seduce
/cast [@mouseover,exists]Axe Toss;Axe Toss
/cast [nopet,@mouseover,exists]Command Demon;[nopet]Command Demon

children.html: Focus Pet Ability 1 Macro -- Casts your main pet abilities for each pet on your focus target.

data.code:
/cast [@focus] Singe Magic
/cast [@focus] Spell Lock
/cast [@focus] Suffering
/cast [@focus] Seduce
/cast [@focus] Axe Toss
/cast [nopet,@focus] Command Demon

children.html: Pet Ability 2 Macro -- Casts your second relevant pet ability on your mouseover target if needed.

data.code:
/cast [@mouseover] Singe Magic
/cast [@mouseover,exists] Devour Magic;Devour Magic
/cast Shadow Bulwark
/cast Felstorm 
/cast [nopet,@mouseover] Command Demon

children.html: Focus Pet Ability 2 Macro -- Casts the second relevant Pet ability on your focus target, also sends your pet to attack your focus.
[[spell:108503]] & dismiss pet -- Casts [[spell:108503]] if you specced into it. If you don't have Grimoire of Sacrifice talented it dismisses your pet instead.

data.code:
#showtooltip
/run if not IsSpellKnown(108503) then PetDismiss(); end
/cast Grimoire of Sacrifice

snapshots.name: Axe Toss
snapshots.description: Xathuux hurls a massive flaming axe at a target and inflicts $s1 Fire damage and interrupts targets within $A1 yards of the impact.

snapshots.name: Axe Toss
snapshots.description: Xathuux the Annihilator throws his massive axe at the location of a random player inflicting $s1 Chaos damage to players within $a yds of the impact. The axe remains on the ground emitting $@spellname1214650 until it is destroyed.

snapshots.name: Axe Toss
snapshots.description: $?s108499[愤怒卫士][恶魔卫士]掷出武器，使目标昏迷并打断目标$89766d。

snapshots.name: Command Demon
snapshots.description:
命令你的恶魔施放威力最强大的技能。该法术的具体效果视你当前召唤的宠物而定。
$?s30146[
恶魔卫士：$@spellname89766][]
地狱猎犬：$@spellname19647
虚空行者：$@spellname17767
夜魔与魅魔：$@spellname6358
小鬼：$@spellname89808

snapshots.name: Axe Toss
snapshots.description: 萨祖克斯朝目标投掷巨大的烈焰战斧，造成$s1点火焰伤害并打断冲击点$A1码范围内的目标的施法。

snapshots.name: Axe Toss
snapshots.description: 歼灭者萨祖克斯将他那把巨斧掷向一名随机玩家的位置，对冲击点$a码范围内的玩家造成$s1点混乱伤害。这把斧头会留在地上并散发$@spellname1214650，直到被摧毁。

snapshots.name: Grimoire of Sacrifice
snapshots.description:
牺牲你的恶魔宠物来获得力量，获得它的恶魔掌控技能，并使你的法术有时会额外造成$196100s1点暗影伤害。

持续$196099d或者直到你召唤出一个恶魔宠物为止。

snapshots.name: Seduction
snapshots.description: 诱惑目标，使其迷惑并不由自主地走向恶魔，持续$6358d。任何伤害可能会解除此效果。只对人型生物有效。

snapshots.name: Shadow Bulwark
snapshots.description:
当前生命值和最大生命值暂时提高$s1%，持续$d。

|cFFFFFFFF自动施法：|r
生命值低于20%时使用该技能。

|cFF777777（右键点击切换）|r

snapshots.name: Spell Lock
snapshots.description: 反制敌人的施法，使其在$19647d内无法施放任何同系法术。

snapshots.name: Singe Magic
snapshots.description:
用烈火净化有害魔法，从一个盟友身上移除$89808s1个有害的魔法效果。

|cFFFFFFFF自动施放：|r
在主人受魔法效果影响，无法施法时对其施放。

|cFF777777（点击右键以启用或禁用该技能）|r
